Steps.Name: ci-test-hangs-with-chromium
Command: chrome --headless --disable-gpu --remote-debugging-port=0 --user-data-dir="$TMPDIR/chromium-profile" about:blank >/dev/null 2>&1 & perl -MPOSIX -e 'POSIX::setsid(); sleep 3600' & perl -MPOSIX -e 'POSIX::setsid(); $SIG{TERM} = "IGNORE"; sleep 3600' & echo "hung on purpose in TMPDIR=$TMPDIR"; sleep 3600
